forward d, back d, turn degrees, setheading a, move x y, home, penup, pendown, color #RRGGBB, width w, circle r; reads xcor, ycor, heading. Also set name value, repeat n [ … ], while … [ … ], if … [ … ] else [ … ], to name a b [ … ], + - * / and functions like sin(a), random(a, b). // starts a comment.
Each step of the game, a rule whose \"when\" blocks all hold runs its \"do\" blocks, top to bottom. A rule with no \"when\" block runs every step.

Runs every step while playing. set name value, if … [ ] else [ ], while … [ ], repeat n [ ], to name a b [ ]. Reads x, y, vx, vy, angle, scale, time, dt, grounded, state, prop(\"p\"), down(\"a\"), pressed(\"a\"), touching(\"Name\"), count(\"Name\"). Does setprop \"p\" v, addprop \"p\" v, goto x y, speed vx vy, turnto a, scaleto s, show, hide, remove, removetouching \"Name\", setstate \"s\".
